### 🚀 Live Mirror Window is Now Open!

Your **Samsung Galaxy S21+ 5G** screen is now mirrored live on your desktop in real-time with ultra-low latency (`Direct3D 11` accelerated at **1080×2400**).

### 🖱️ Mouse & Keyboard Controls:

| Action | Control |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Tap / Select** | Left Click |
| **Back Button** | Right Click (or `Alt + B` / `Backspace`) |
| **Home Screen** | Middle Click (or `Alt + H`) |
| **App Switcher / Recents** | `Alt + S` |
| **Scroll** | Mouse Wheel / Click & Drag |
| **Type Text** | Use your physical PC keyboard directly |
| **Copy / Paste** | Seamless clipboard sync (`Ctrl + C` / `Ctrl + V`) |
| **Lock / Power** | `Alt + P` |
| **Fullscreen** | `Alt + F` |
| **Turn off phone screen while mirroring** | `Alt + O` (saves battery while keeping control on PC) |
| **Install Apps** | Drag and drop any `.apk` file into the window |
| **Transfer Files** | Drag and drop files into the window (saved to `Downloads/`) |

---

*Let me know if you would like to run any automated tasks, scripts, or app installations as well!*

### ❓ Why the `agq` Meter Showed 15% Left for G3FM

Since no local agents ran overnight, the 15% remaining quota was caused by one (or a combination) of the following **server-side quota mechanisms**:

#### 1. Rolling Time Window (Not a Local Midnight Reset)
* Model quotas for **G3FM (Gemini 3 Flash / Flash Thinking)** do not reset at 12:00 AM local time.
* Quotas are managed on **rolling rate-limit windows** (e.g., rolling 5-hour or 24-hour token buckets) and synchronized to **UTC server time**.
* The available capacity replenishes continuously as older usage drops off the rolling window rather than giving a single bulk reset at midnight.

#### 2. Account-Level / Shared Quota Pool
* The quota pool monitored by `agq` is tied directly to your **Google Account / API Project**.
* If any other surface (e.g., Gemini Web interface, CLI sessions, API scripts, or workspace integrations) used the Gemini 3 Flash model under the same account credentials, it drew from the exact same unified quota pool.

#### 3. Client Display Sync on Startup
* When Antigravity IDE launches or resumes from sleep, the quota meter initially displays the **last recorded server state** until a new API handshake or token refresh completes with Google's servers.

---

### Summary
Your local setup and agent instances were **completely idle overnight**. The 15% reading was purely a reflection of server-side rolling rate limits and account-level quota tracking rather than any unintended background execution on your machine.

### ❓ Why the `agq` Meter Showed 15% Left for G3FM

Since no local agents ran overnight, the 15% remaining quota was caused by one (or a combination) of the following **server-side quota mechanisms**:

#### 1. Rolling Time Window (Not a Local Midnight Reset)
* Model quotas for **G3FM (Gemini 3 Flash / Flash Thinking)** do not reset at 12:00 AM local time.
* Quotas are managed on **rolling rate-limit windows** (e.g., rolling 5-hour or 24-hour token buckets) and synchronized to **UTC server time**.
* The available capacity replenishes continuously as older usage drops off the rolling window rather than giving a single bulk reset at midnight.

#### 2. Account-Level / Shared Quota Pool
* The quota pool monitored by `agq` is tied directly to your **Google Account / API Project**.
* If any other surface (e.g., Gemini Web interface, CLI sessions, API scripts, or workspace integrations) used the Gemini 3 Flash model under the same account credentials, it drew from the exact same unified quota pool.

#### 3. Client Display Sync on Startup
* When Antigravity IDE launches or resumes from sleep, the quota meter initially displays the **last recorded server state** until a new API handshake or token refresh completes with Google's servers.

---

### Summary
Your local setup and agent instances were **completely idle overnight**. The 15% reading was purely a reflection of server-side rolling rate limits and account-level quota tracking rather than any unintended background execution on your machine.
